default.title: LeClap — Video Composer for Browser, Phone & AI Agents
default.description: Compose videos from one JSON template in your browser or on your phone — no uploads. For agentic development, coding agents attach before/after videos to PRs.

studio.title: Studio
studio.description: Pick a template and compose your video right in the browser — trim, crop, add music, and export with on-device FFmpeg. No uploads, no servers.

about.title: About
about.description: LeClap renders a JSON template and your own footage into a finished video with FFmpeg — in a terminal, a browser or on a phone. Its story, and who makes it.

compareRemotion.title: LeClap vs Remotion — on-device video rendering compared
compareRemotion.description: Both render video deterministically from code. Remotion composes in React and needs a browser engine; LeClap renders a JSON template natively on-device. An honest side-by-side.

legal.title: Legal Notice
legal.description: Who publishes and hosts LeClap — the open, browser-based cinematic video composer.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: LeClap processes your media on your device. No uploads, no accounts, no tracking — here is exactly how your privacy is handled.

showcase.title: Motion showcase
showcase.description: Watch every LeClap sample, explore native and Remotion motion, read the creative direction and download editable JSON templates.
